style.vernacular: Hill-country microstate on Monte Titano: the old town is built of pale grey-beige local limestone and sandstone with narrow cobbled lanes, medieval walls, towers and crenellated palaces under terracotta tile roofs. The lowland (Serravalle, Dogana, Domagnano) is Italian-style modern: two to five storey render and concrete blocks in cream, ochre and grey with clay-tile or flat roofs, shopping centres and sports grounds.
style.ornament: Battlements (merlons) on corbels, slender towers on the crag, pointed Gothic-revival windows on the Palazzo Pubblico, neoclassical Corinthian columns and pediment on the Basilica, flags and the three-feather coat of arms, blue and white national colours on signs and seats.
